name: Thadius Grimshade
summary: At Nethergarde Keep, Thadius Grimshade seeks knowledge in divination and darker magic. Though long gone from Aerie Peak, he remains loyal to his kin.

sections.title: A Wildhammer in the Wastes
sections.body: Thadius Grimshade lives within Nethergarde Keep, far from the open skies and roaring winds favored by most Wildhammer dwarves. He came to the edge of the tainted Blasted Lands to study arcane divination and darker mystic lore. Though apart from his clan, he still cherishes his homeland and gryphonkind. When folk from Aerie Peak seek his aid, he offers his rare skill in scrying.

sections.title: The Price of Divination
sections.body: When Gryphon Master Talonaxe seeks the captured gryphon Sharpbeak, Thadius performs a divination ritual with one of the beast's feathers. For his aid, he demands the medallion worn by the troll necromancer Nekrum Gutchewer. Thadius seeks its secret of unnatural longevity while trying to avoid its corrupting harm. With the medallion, he pierces the veil of Jintha'Alor and reveals where Sharpbeak is held.

faq.answer: Thadius Grimshade is a Wildhammer dwarf mage and diviner at Nethergarde Keep. He left his mountain home to study darker, unorthodox magic far to the south.

faq.q: Where can Thadius Grimshade be found?
faq.answer: Thadius Grimshade lives inside the high wizard tower at Nethergarde Keep, an Alliance stronghold in the northern Blasted Lands.

faq.q: Why does he want Nekrum's Medallion?
faq.answer: Thadius wants the medallion carried by Nekrum Gutchewer to learn how its magic grants long life and seek that longevity without suffering its sinister side effects.

faq.q: How does he help find Sharpbeak?
faq.answer: Thadius uses a feather shed by the missing gryphon and Nekrum's Medallion in a scrying ritual. It reveals Sharpbeak is held at the heights of Jintha'Alor in the Hinterlands.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you may find Thadius an oddity among the Wildhammers. Rather than soar on gryphons, he spends his years in arcane study inside a human fortress.
As a mage visiting Nethergarde, you may recognize Thadius's rare methods of divination. He studies troll relics in hopes of mastering longevity magic.
